_doc: The cloud routines as configured at claude.ai/code/routines: one source for dispatch.py, the console and smctl. The Builder updates this file in the same PR as any routine change (schedule, model, trigger, on/off). cron is UTC; null means no schedule.

coordinator.name: streaming_media Coordinator
triggers: Dispatcher: a new unplaced issue, needs-human or needs-coordinator, a Fixer comment on a #64 item

fixer.name: streaming_media Fixer
triggers: Dispatcher: an eligible #64 item has waited 60 min with no Fixer working

fixer_b.name: streaming_media Fixer B
triggers: Dispatcher: a Fixer is working and another eligible #64 item is free (on demand only)

reviewer.name: streaming_media Reviewer
triggers: GitHub: a label is added to a PR (ci-passed when ci-ok succeeds)
Dispatcher: a green PR waits 30 min for review, or needs-human was removed after its review

tester.name: streaming_media Tester
triggers: Dispatcher: fixes to verify, 3+ product merges since its last run, or a PR waits for its probe (needs-probe)

builder.name: streaming_media Builder
triggers: Dispatcher: an issue or PR carries needs-builder
